dHash: RGB -> cv2 gray -> INTER_AREA 9x8 -> horizontal comparisons -> big-endian64
candidate_edge: All three dHash distances <=4 or all three native RGB hashes equal; file SHA exact and known aliases/forbidden-content edges also included
whole_video_duplicate_proof: file SHA only; anchor matching does not establish whole-video equality
dispersed_screen: For every accessible archive and external YUV source, window starts round((frames-64)*k/4), k=0..4; native RGB anchors start+0/31/63. All sampled window triples compared across all sources, including train/history/reserved, before selecting dev/test. No model quality is read.
